nom: Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleansing Cloths Twin Pack

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the cloths clean effectively without irritation, including one reviewer whose dry, mature skin tolerated them well and who found they removed even waterproof mascara.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly describe the cloths as gentle and non-irritating for daily makeup removal and refreshing, though several reviewers with sensitive skin report the reformulated version burns, stings, itches, or leaves a sticky residue.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin reports the reformulated version is not gentle and left their face sticky, itchy, and red.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s with sensitive, dry skin reports the cloths are soft and gentle and remove even waterproof mascara well.

concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers report the reformulated wipes cause stickiness, itching, redness, burning, or an allergic-type reaction, in sharp contrast to how gentle they found the previous formula; other reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, still report no redness or irritation.
concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers find the cloths slightly drying on the skin, needing more pressure to remove makeup, though most describe them as non-drying and refreshing.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the wipes help improve the skin's moisture barrier while removing makeup, without triggering flare-ups on their eczema- and acne-prone skin.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin report the wipes clean without causing breakouts or rashes and help keep their skin clear.

aspects.libelle: Reformulated version leaves sticky, itchy, or burning residue
Convenient resealable pack for travel, gym, or purse
Doesn't fully replace washing your face
Cloths dry out faster than expected in the pack

extraits.texte: I have been using these almost daily for years. I wish I'd known the formula was changed when I purchased my recent packs. I am allergic to ingredients in the new formula. This is so, so disappointing as someone with sensitive skin. Please, bring back the old formula!

extraits.titre: If it ain't broke, don't fix it
extraits.texte: These used to be the best face cleansing cloths available. They did the job while going on light and without a residue. The new and "improved" formulation is trash and left my face a sticky, itchy red mess. I have normal skin. These are not gentle. Sometimes the best fix is no fix at all. Did you even consumer test these before releasing this new formulation? I wish I'd checked all the bad reviews before buying these at the store.

extraits.titre: Best cleansing cloth I have tried
extraits.texte: I love these cleansing cloths. My face is dry and I am never bothered by using them. I do not use daily but at least a few times a week and I continue to buy them. I am on my 6th repurchase and still happy. They are soft and gentle for my sensitive, 40+ year old skin. Makeup comes off easily and even with waterproof mascara I find they do the job well. Will 100% continue to purchase.

Cetaphil is such a lifesaver for my eczema and acne prone skin! These wipes provide moisture without irritating the skin barrier or causing flare ups. Patch test, of course, but I'd give these a try if you also have sensitive skin!

I like these wipes for quick makeup removal, especially after the gym. They smell super fresh and help my skin feel clean without leaving any oily residue. Sometimes they can feel a little strong around the eyes, but overall they do a great job and are perfect for acne-prone skin when I'm on the go

extraits.titre: An okay product, room for improvement.
extraits.texte: I didn't mind this product but it was not my favourite, i felt like the wipes were on the dryer side which caused me to use more force when taking my make up off. The scent was not bad, but i again prefer scent less. It compared close in price to the neutogena ones i usually would purchase.
